How do I enroll in the Full-Time Tuition-Paid Program?

To enroll, follow these steps:

Step 1: Submit an Application: Complete the online application form and submit required documents (e.g., birth certificate and previous transcripts, if applicable).

Step 2: Confirmation: Once your application is reviewed and accepted, you will receive confirmation of your enrollment.

Step 3: Course Selection: Meet with an academic adviser to choose your courses based on your grade level, academic goals and interests.

Step 4: Begin Learning: After enrollment, students can start their courses at any time and access all online resources.

Texas Tech K-12 Elementary School Program Requirements

Texas Tech Elementary School: As a full-time Texas Tech K-12 elementary student, you must maintain academic progress in a minimum of four courses concurrently.

After you complete both first (A) and second (B) semesters of all four core subject areas in your grade level, you will receive a report card. Upon successful completion of these four core subject areas, you will be promoted to the next grade level.

In accordance with Texas Education Code §25.001, children must be 5 years old on or before September 1 of the school year to enroll in Kindergarten. Children who turn 5 after September 1 are not eligible for Kindergarten enrollment. This includes part-time or supplemental enrollment and applies to all programs and enrollments.

Supplemental Program Information

Anyone looking to supplement their current school curriculum or home school curriculum can enroll in Texas Tech K-12.  Our Texas Tech K-12 Supplemental Program (opens in new tab) is designed to allow students in elementary, middle and high school that allows students to work at their own pace. We have students who must do their work at home for various reasons, such as travel "outside" of the U.S. for extended amounts of time, have health issues, are actors, entertainers, and athletes who cannot fit the traditional schooling into their schedule. We have school all year and do not keep a traditional academic schedule, so it is possible to move through our program faster than the typical semester-based programs.

Link for "Supplemental Program (opens in new tab)": https://www.depts.ttu.edu/k12/courses/

This is a self-paced program where all the instructional content is provided. The courses tend to be reading and writing intensive. Online courses require self-discipline and excellent time-management skills. The courses are not virtual classrooms and do not require any interaction with any other students or instructors. Each course has lessons, which are like chapters, and a final exam. The final exam will be proctored online by an online proctoring service.

**Enrollment Timeline for the Supplemental Program**

- Texas Tech K-12 operates on open enrollment and does not follow a semester schedule.
- You can enroll in a supplemental (part-time) course at any time during the year.
- Once you select your course from the course catalog and complete the intake form, your enrollment will be processed.
- There is no specific processing timeframe stated, but after submitting your application and payment, you should receive access to your course(s) promptly.

**Next Steps**

- Select your course from the [course catalog](https://ttu.focusschoolsoftware.com/focus/catalog/?_gl=1*xvyjah*_gcl_au*NTY5NzA2ODU2LjE3MzA4NDA5OTY.*_ga*MjU0NDE2Nzg2LjE3MjMwNDQ2MTA.*_ga_TSPQSJQPQF*MTczMjAyNjMxMS4xNjcuMS4xNzMyMDI2MzIwLjAuMC4w).
- Complete the intake form and submit your application.
- If you have questions about your enrollment status or need assistance, contact Texas Tech K-12 at 1-800-692-6877 or email ttuk12@ttu.edu.

**Tip:** If you are enrolled in another school, make sure to obtain approval from your school counselor before enrolling to ensure credit will be awarded.
